$schema.description: Canonical URI of the immutable JSON Schema contract for this payment transaction.

paymentId.description: ID of the payment this payment transaction belongs to.

statusDetails.description: Normalized status details exposed as part of the public API contract. This field is not PSP raw data; PSP-specific technical payload belongs to pspData.

example.message: The payment was declined by the provider.

pspData.description: Sanitized PSP data exposed for debugging and reconciliation. Sensitive values must be filtered by the PSP adapter before storing or returning this field.

PaymentTransactionStatus.description: Current status of the payment transaction. PENDING: non-terminal; the payment is awaiting customer/provider action or the PSP did not return a definitive outcome. SUCCESS: terminal; the PSP definitively confirmed successful payment. FAILED: terminal; the PSP definitively confirmed a negative payment outcome, or the customer cancelled or allowed the attempt to expire. A new retry is a new payment transaction.

StatusDetails.description: Normalized status details for payment transaction status.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable detail code. Canonical codes are AWAITING_CUSTOMER, PROCESSING, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID, COMPLETED, PAYMENT_FAILED, DECLINED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, and PROVIDER_REJECTED. Provider-specific raw statuses belong to pspData and must not be used by clients for gateway orchestration decisions.

message.example: The payment was declined by the provider.
